attempts.summary: On node1, set up LVM-backed /srv/data (loopback-backed vgdata/datalv, since the node had no spare disk or existing LVM), populated it with application data, took an LVM snapshot, then corrupted/deleted/added files to simulate drift. Restored the exact pre-modification content via lvconvert --merge (a real LVM snapshot rollback) and verified it byte-for-byte identical to the baseline via sha256sum. The loop device / VG were made boot-persistent (systemd unit ordered before local-fs.target + fstab entry with x-systemd.requires) so /srv/data survives restarts. Completed the mandatory node1 restart sequence: captured a pre-restart boot_id and verified-healthy baseline, issued a native reboot, polled through the outage, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified /srv/data remounted with all data still checksum-matching the snapshot baseline.
